The '''Battle of Panna''' was fought between the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] of [[Xer VIII|Xer]] and the [[Kingdom of Cron]] in the [[Pre-Republic era]], at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Panna/Legends|Panna]].

When the pirate Xer began rapid expansion of the [[Kingdom of Argai]] within the Kingdom of Cron, [[King of Cron]] [[Ferece]] summoned Xer to [[Chandaar]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Kingdom of Cron. Ferece tried to persuade Xer give an oath of fealty, in return for a number of noble titles, and Xer promised to return in a month with a suitable tribute. However, he gathered a sizable fleet at Panna and attacked Ferece's forces. Following the battle, Xer [[Battle of Duinarbulon|attacked]] [[Duinarbulon]].
